parameters.query: SELECT brand_name, hook, core_angle, ad_type, start_date FROM public.ads WHERE start_date >= now() - interval '7 days' AND analyzed_at IS NOT NULL AND enrichment_error IS NULL ORDER BY brand_name, start_date DESC;
